interpretations: For each `telescref` with at least one non-NULL `modindex`, calculate `AVG(modindex)`; calculate the overall mean across those telescope averages; retain telescopes above that mean; divide each retained telescope’s average by the mean of the retained averages; return the 10 highest ratios with `telescref`, the unrounded telescope average, its unrounded difference from the overall mean, and the unrounded ratio.
queries:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
    SELECT telescref, AVG(modindex) AS telescope_avg
    FROM signals
    WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY telescref
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(telescope_avg) AS overall_mean
    FROM telescope_averages
),
retained AS (
    SELECT ta.telescref,
           ta.telescope_avg,
           ta.telescope_avg - o.overall_mean AS difference
    FROM telescope_averages AS ta
    CROSS JOIN overall AS o
    WHERE ta.telescope_avg > o.overall_mean
),
retained_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(telescope_avg) AS mean_avg
    FROM retained
)
SELECT r.telescref,
       r.telescope_avg,
       r.difference,
       r.telescope_avg / rm.mean_avg AS ratio
FROM retained AS r
CROSS JOIN retained_mean AS rm
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
